Name: Jashobeam, Son of Zabdiel
Summary: Chief of David's captains, who lifted his spear against three hundred slain at one time.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 11:11; 1 Chronicles 27:2: Chief of David's captains, who lifted his spear against three hundred slain at one time.
LifeLesson: The mention of Jashobeam in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
